risks: Pending maintainer source, baseline, schema/ID, rights or release approvals block acceptance and publication for the dataset pipelines described in the issues.
Issues #308 and #301 are shown as Closed as not planned, so their pipeline work cannot be assumed released.
No private security-reporting process was shown in the pages read, so a security finding has no verified private channel from these sources.
The pages do not identify which specific unfinished dataset files in the local artifact set correspond to which issue, so target-specific release status remains unverified.
unknowns: The official private security-reporting process for fulton-ring/hifld-next-datasets is not established by the pages read.: A SECURITY.md, GitHub private vulnerability reporting page, or official disclosure policy for the repository.

The release status of the specific unfinished dataset is not established by the pages read.: A mapping from the local unfinished dataset files to a specific issue and its maintainer source, rights and release approval.
wouldChangeMind: Finding an official SECURITY.md or GitHub private vulnerability reporting path for fulton-ring/hifld-next-datasets would change the disclosure conclusion.
Finding maintainer source, rights and release approvals for a specific dataset issue would change its release-status conclusion.
Finding a file-level mapping from the local unfinished dataset to a specific issue would identify the target project behind that dataset.
